what: Pre-deletion parity gate is not mechanically runnable
scenario_or_breakage: The testing strategy says to run retired `scripts/test-dispatch-with-waterfall.sh` once against the new verb, but every harness case hardcodes `$REPO_ROOT/scripts/dispatch-with-waterfall.sh`. After the script is deleted (or before a forwarder exists), that gate cannot run as written, so parity may be assumed without execution.
suggested_fix: Replace the parity-gate bullet with an explicit procedure: either (a) temporarily install a forwarder at `scripts/dispatch-with-waterfall.sh` that execs `python3 "$PLUGIN_ROOT/python/cli.py" agent dispatch-waterfall`, run the harness, then delete both; or (b) declare `python/test_agent_waterfall.py` the sole parity authority and drop the retired-harness rerun step.

scenario_or_breakage: The plan repoints only the invocation and says "No other behavior change", but the non-zero path still logs `dispatch-with-waterfall.sh exited` at `scripts/dispatch-code-voters.sh:153`. Operators and log triage will see a deleted entrypoint name after cutover.
suggested_fix: Extend the `### UPDATED: scripts/dispatch-code-voters.sh` step to reword the `larch_err` at line 153 to `agent dispatch-waterfall` (keep `set +e` / `set -e` semantics unchanged).
